title: Document examples to verify your identity
summary: This page provides examples of identity documents that may be required when using a NSW Government service online.
intro:
When you use a NSW Government service online, you may need to provide details from an identity document.

Here are examples of the types of document you may be asked for.
what_you_need: Australian certificate of registration by descent
Aviation and Maritime Security Identification Card

faqs.q: What types of documents can I use to verify my identity online?
faqs.a: You may be asked for details from documents such as an Australian driver licence, foreign passport (Australian visa), Australian birth certificate, or Australian certificate of registration by descent.

faqs.q: What information is needed from an Australian birth certificate?
faqs.a: The required details vary by the certificate's issue date. For example, certificates issued from 13 October 2014 show the certificate number on the back under the barcode. For certificates issued before 1999, you may need the registration number (the number after the slash '/').

faqs.q: What is required for an Australian certificate of registration by descent?
faqs.a: If the certificate was issued after 2007, you can enter the client ID number. If it was issued before 2007, you must enter the register number and entry number, separated by a slash (e.g., 243/87).
